acceptanceCriteria.text: Ephemeral local Supabase Docker container starts and seeds in CI runner
npx @usebruno/cli runs Bruno API suite against local container
Playwright E2E tests run against local web server & DB and upload HTML reports on failure/completion

snapshot.description: Extend .github/workflows/ci-quality-gate.yml with jobs that initialize an ephemeral local Supabase Docker environment (npx supabase start), apply seed data, run Bruno API regression collection, and run Playwright E2E tests with artifact uploads.
snapshot.title: Ephemeral Local Supabase Docker & Automated API/E2E Test Jobs
